title: Marble Mayhem - Fall Guys X Marble Blast
author: sp00ked_yuh

comments.author: sp00ked_yuh
comments.body:
Hey all, wanted to share progress of a game i'm working on. It's for mobile, PC, tablet, also allows for controller use. The concept was a marble royale type game that starts with 100 marbles and gets down to a single winner over the course of 4 legs of a race. 

It quickly evolved with a fall guys type approach with various mini games and randomizer to keep it exciting. then i built out the customization of skins, trails, victory animations. then along came forging marbles from shards that you collect during races to create your own unique marbles. the music was made with suno so each level has it's own theme for the particular type of theme the level has. there's a cinematic winners video replay if you finish in first with some game credits. 

cheat codes that apply to any and all maps to make it fun like low gravity, twisters sucking you up and throwing you off the map, and 500 marbles instead of 100 to name a few. still a work in progress but wanted to share what i had so far.

i started building the app on 11/2 so only about 9 days worth of work so far. most of the build came out of the first day and has been growing since then.
